scene_description: A narrow, bright galley kitchen with a teal stove on the left, white cabinetry and a long counter on the right, and a doorway and potted plant at the back.
initial_target_observations: The initial right countertop is largely plain white with a few thin, sparse diagonal gray marks; it lacks the reference's broad, flowing marble-like veining.
candidate_target_observations: The candidate right countertop remains very pale and nearly uniform, with at most extremely faint streaking. It does not reproduce the prominent gray, flowing marble-like texture in the reference.
geometric_plausibility_observations: The stove, cabinet runs, plant and rear doorway form a coherent galley layout. The candidate shows a narrow, nearly edge-on door leaf with a dark opening behind it, closer to the reference's open doorway than the initial broad white leaf occluding much of the opening. The stove remains oversized in the foreground and its simplified flat burners and panel differ from the reference. Image evidence alone cannot establish physical contact or hidden geometry.
new_visible_defects: The already sparse countertop markings are less apparent in the candidate, leaving a flatter surface compared with the reference. The candidate door leaf reads as a thin white vertical strip rather than the reference's dark-edged angled leaf.
other_changes: The rear doorway changes from partly occluded by a broad white leaf to a mostly visible dark gradient opening. The candidate also displays a faint clock on the stove panel that is not discernible in the initial image. Both reconstructions retain flatter materials, weaker contrast, and more diffuse lighting than the reference; their viewpoint is more frontal and lower, with the stove more tightly cropped.

evidence.description: The right countertop has broad gray-white marble-like streaks and visible tonal variation.
The pale right countertop has a few fine diagonal marks but little of the reference's broad veining.
The right countertop appears almost uniformly white, with the earlier thin marks much less evident.
A dark-edged open door borders a tall dark-gradient opening at the rear.
A broad white door leaf covers much of the rear opening.
The opening is mostly exposed and the leaf appears as a narrow light strip on its right.

uncertainty: The countertop is very bright in both reconstructions, so subtle texture may be suppressed by exposure and image resolution. The target judgment concerns visible countertop appearance only; the doorway improvement is separate and does not imply verified mesh contact or hidden geometry.
